decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records retention of individual JST connectors rather than one consolidated connector; no additional layout-state change is missing.
The connector-consolidation decision does not change power-source OR-ing, source selection, or diode requirements.
Retaining individual JST connectors does not alter the existing panel-control mappings or their connection-through-connectors behavior.
The source decision concerns connector architecture and does not change any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The sensor-board state already defines separate connectors for individual sensor modules, and the source does not change their types, pinouts, or count.
Connector consolidation has no necessary effect on monitored rails, monitor placement, or the selected current-monitor IC.
The source does not change LED supply voltage, switching, data-level handling, or level-shifter requirements.
Retaining individual connectors does not modify the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The connector architecture decision is unrelated to the buzzer type or accepted part.
The source preserves the ESP32 edge placement but does not change breakout coverage or through-hole placement requirements.
The source reiterates that boards slide into rails but does not change the sensor board's established orientation, connector alignment, or component-placement policy.
The existing separate power-and-signal interboard architecture remains valid; the source does not change connector types, signals, pin ordering, or matching-numbering requirements.
